detail.longDescription: Your follow-ups are only as good as your meeting notes. Wispr Notetaker gets your words and your speakers right, so your recaps, follow-ups, and answers are too. Before the meeting starts, it checks the invite so names are spelled correctly, and it brings the terminology you've already taught Wispr Flow into every conversation. Your transcripts use real names instead of "Speaker 1" and "Speaker 2," and every meeting is ready to pull into Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Available on Mac. Free to try.
